instruction:
Work from `/home/user/Desktop/pitch_step.fst`, `/home/user/Desktop/servo_step_base.dat`, and an NREL 5 MW dependency set. Additional initialization dependencies are pre-uploaded under `/home/user/Desktop` with relative structure preserved. Only initialization inputs are included; no answer/result artifacts are preloaded.

Complete a deterministic collective-pitch maneuver from the command line. 1. Write `/home/user/Desktop/build_case.py`. Create `/home/user/Desktop/servo_step.dat` from the template and set `TPitManS(1..3)=30.0 s`, `PitManRat(1..3)=10.0 deg/s`, and `BlPitchF(1..3)=10.0 deg`. 2. Create `/home/user/Desktop/elasto_step.dat` and `/home/user/Desktop/aero_step.dat` from the supplied ElastoDyn and AeroDyn files, normalize their dependency paths to the desktop `5MW_Baseline` tree, and request `BldPitch1`, `BldPitch2`, and `BldPitch3` from ElastoDyn. Create `/home/user/Desktop/case.fst` from the main template; set `TMax=60`, `DT_Out=0.1`, `OutFileFmt=1`, and point `EDFile`, `AeroFile`, and `ServoFile` to the generated files. Keep the supplied 12 m/s inflow and controller configuration. 3. Run `/home/user/miniconda3/bin/openfast case.fst`, retain the native text output `/home/user/Desktop/case.out`, and save the console log as `/home/user/Desktop/case.log`; require normal termination. 4. Write `/home/user/Desktop/postprocess.py`. From the native `BldPitch1/2/3` and `GenPwr` channels, compute mean `GenPwr` in kW over `20 <= t < 30 s` and `40 <= t <= 50 s`. Average the three blade pitches, define the 10% and 90% thresholds between the pre-maneuver mean pitch and 10 degrees, and report the elapsed time from first crossing 10% to first crossing 90%. 5. Save `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt` as one comma-separated row `pre_pwr_kw,post_pwr_kw,pitch_rise_time_s`. Do not use GUI tools.
